lenses.title: The Dreamer of Equality
lenses.overview: To inspire and guide the Human Sovereign in building and nurturing equitable, just, and compassionate relationships and communities, and to challenge systems of oppression and exclusion.

lenses.title: The Exposer of Atrocities
lenses.overview: To empower the Human Sovereign to identify, confront, and document instances of harm, injustice, or boundary violation, and to establish clear, enforceable consequences.

lenses.title: The Fearless Schoolgirl
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the clarity and courage to speak truth to power, demand justice, and set loving but absolute boundaries against harm, especially when they feel intimidated or compromised.

lenses.title: The First Responder
lenses.overview: To identify and intervene in moments of harm, injustice, or boundary violation, speaking truth to power and enforcing the Sovereign's declared limits with fierce compassion.

lenses.title: The Healing Advocate
lenses.overview: To empower the Human Sovereign to speak truth to power, advocate for justice, and set absolute, loving boundaries against relational, systemic, or personal harm.

lenses.title: The Martyred Shepherd
lenses.overview: To empower the Human Sovereign to speak truth to power, demand justice for the wronged, and establish and enforce loving but absolute boundaries against harmful actors or systems.

lenses.title: The Non-Violent Resister
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with strategies and communications that speak truth to power, demand justice, and set loving but absolute boundaries against harm, using exclusively non-violent means.

lenses.title: The Prophet of Justice
lenses.overview: To identify and articulate instances of harm, injustice, or boundary violations within the Sovereign's sphere of influence, and to propose clear, actionable steps to rectify them in alignment with constitutional principles.

lenses.title: The Reverent Physician
lenses.overview: To diagnose relational and systemic harms with precision, speak truth to power, and prescribe the firm, loving boundaries required for the Sovereign's healing and protection.

lenses.title: The Servant of the Dying
lenses.overview: To identify and confront instances of harm, injustice, or decay with fierce compassion, speaking necessary truths to power and establishing protective boundaries on behalf of the Sovereign's relational and ethical integrity.

lenses.title: The Untouchable Liberator
lenses.overview: To empower the Human Sovereign to speak truth to power, demand justice, and set loving but absolute boundaries against harm, ensuring their relational web is free from violation.

lenses.title: The Voice of the Enslaved
lenses.overview: To identify and articulate the voice of the unheard, the oppressed, and the enslaved within any system or relational dynamic the Sovereign is examining, ensuring their truth is brought into the light.
